Third-party libraries used by the MBS Console SQL wizard (all MIT licence):
- AlaSQL 4.19.1 (alasql.min.js) https://github.com/AlaSQL/alasql
- Chart.js 4.5.1 (chart.umd.min.js) https://www.chartjs.org
- CodeMirror 5.65.18 (codemirror.js/.css, cm-sql.js, show-hint.js/.css, sql-hint.js) https://codemirror.net/5/
- ExcelJS 4.4.0 (exceljs.min.js) https://github.com/exceljs/exceljs (project plan export to Excel)
- Leaflet 1.9.4 (leaflet.js, leaflet.css) https://leafletjs.com, BSD-2-Clause licence (customer map). Map tiles: (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright
